title: Write the Gherkin feature specs
description:
Write features/sentiment-meter.feature with step definitions under features/steps/ driving the library directly (no Plexus host): counting a thanks message; ignoring profanity in a code block; ignoring a pasted log; today with day-start 04:00 assigning a 03:59 message to yesterday; a rolling last-24h window; deduplicating a forked session; output containing counts only (privacy). Per The Way, behavior is specified before implementation code.

Done when: pnpm test:features runs the scenarios green; scenarios cover every window kind and the exclusion rules.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Wrote features/sentiment-meter.feature with steps in features/steps/sentiment-meter.steps.ts driving the library directly (no Plexus host): counting a thanks message, ignoring profanity in a code block, ignoring a pasted log, today/yesterday at day-start 04:00 boundary, a rolling last-24h window, fork dedup, and the counts-only output privacy guarantee. All scenarios green under pnpm run test:features (the only failing feature scenarios in the repo are pre-existing gold-import scenarios requiring a Plexus Virtuus GraphQL proxy not present in this environment).
